# `admin.token.list`

List another user's agent tokens

Site admins only. Shows token prefixes, scopes, and expiry. Secrets never leave the minting response.

- Method and path: `GET /admin/users/{user}/tokens`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie admin token list`
- MCP: `admin_token_list`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
